results.title: Plunkett Research Online: Dorman Products Inc
results.snippet: Sources describe it as a supplier of replacement and upgrade parts for passenger cars, light trucks, and medium- and heavy-duty trucks. It serves the motor vehicle aftermarket in the United States and internationally.

results.title: Newest light and heavy duty repair innovations reinforce Dormans leadership of the automotive aftermarket 2024
results.snippet: It sells heavy duty aftermarket parts for class 4-8 vehicles, such as lighting, cooling, engine management, wheel hardware. One 2024 release described suspension control arms built to match original equipment fit and function.

results.title: Dorman Suspension Parts
results.snippet: Its catalog covers suspension arms, knuckles, links, bushings, leaf springs, other suspension, steering, and brake components. Its chassis line also includes control arms.

results.title: fundamentei.com
results.snippet: The company distributes fasteners, air suspensions, keyless remotes, window regulators, door lock actuators, loaded knuckles, and other products. Products are sold under the DORMAN, HELP!, OE FIX, Conduct-Tite, and HD Solutions brands, through automotive aftermarket retailers, such as on-line platforms; national, regional, and local warehouse distributors; and specialty markets, among others.

results.title: financialmodelingprep.com
results.snippet: Dorman Products is an auto aftermarket supplier that sells a broad range of replacement parts, including chassis, suspension, fastener, and heavy-duty products. The company operates through three business segments, which include Light Duty, Heavy Duty, and Specialty Vehicle.

results.title: roic.ai
results.snippet: Its hardware line includes threaded bolts and auto body fasteners. Other heavy-duty items include air tanks, and its Dayton Parts brand covers trailer air tank reservoirs.
